package.name: genie_sim_planning
package.description:
Python tooling and scripts for the GenieSim chassis pipeline (teleop, navigation, follow_trajectory). The C++ four-wheel-steering servo, strategies, MPC solver and tracking differentiator are provided by genie_sim_controllers.
Includes LQR / discrete Riccati helpers adapted from Atsushi Sakai's PythonRobotics (MIT-licensed) — see THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md for the full attribution.
